artigo.titulo: How to care for English ivy indoors

legenda: English ivy forgives a lot, but it hates soggy soil, dark corners and hot, dry air. Bright light, a drainage hole and a finger in the soil keep it happy.

beats.texto: Is your ivy sitting in soggy soil?!
But standing water rots the roots.
In a dark corner?! It grows thin.
Next to a radiator?! Dry air brings spider mites.
Dry on top?! Water, and let it drain.
Every ivy is different. There's an app that tells you when.
